$comment: Shopify's Node libraries (#67, #83): `new shopify.clients.Graphql({ session }).request(document, { variables })` (`@shopify/shopify-api`, also `shopify.api.clients` of the Express app package) and `admin.graphql(document, { variables })` from `authenticate.admin(request)` (the Remix and React Router app packages). The REST client (`new shopify.clients.Rest({ session }).get({ path: "products" })`, `admin.rest.get(...)`) requests `/admin/api/{version}/<path>.json`; the REST resources (`shopify.rest.Product.all({ session })`, also `admin.rest.resources` of the app packages: `keyAliases`), generated from the paths of @shopify/shopify-api 15's 2026-07 resources (#92: a one-off script), take their ids from the argument; a method with several paths lists the others in `paths`, the library picks the most specific one whose ids it is given (`Metafield.all({ session, product_id })`). A record built with `new shopify.rest.Product({ session })` sends through its own methods (#92, keys `rest.<Class>#<method>`): `save()` POSTs the properties the code set on it, or PUTs them once it sets the `id` (`record.withId`), `delete()` and the resource's own (`order.close()`) take their ids from it (`record:<id>`). #102: a record read with `find` (`recordFrom`: `const p = await shopify.rest.Product.find({ session, id })` then `p.save()`) holds the ids `find` was given. `shopify.auth.tokenExchange`, `refreshToken`, `callback` and `clientCredentials` request an access token (`/admin/oauth/access_token`), `clients.graphqlProxy({ session, rawBody })` forwards the client's document. The shop is the session's: its host stays `{shop}.myshopify.com`.
